candidates.statement: Order service postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests time out at the gateway and return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle are point-in-time trace attributes; no pool wait-time or saturation metric was admitted to confirm exhaustion versus slow postgres.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order ReadTimeout and postgres.save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, while inventory and payment calls succeed. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. This bounds the fault to order's postgres dependency, consistent with pool exhaustion; logs were excluded and pool saturation metrics are absent.
